roles.primary: Blue. The interactive colour: links, focus rings, selected cards and rows, checkboxes, radios, toggles, active tabs and nav, the current day. Same value family as accent and ring.
roles.accent: Blue. Same role as primary; prefer it for text links and focus.
roles.cta: Green. Only the one create/new call-to-action button on a page (bg-cta text-cta-foreground hover:bg-cta/90). Never for focus, selection, links or icons.
roles.success: Green. Status only: online, passed, done, operational.
roles.attention: Amber. Warnings, pending, usage above 80 percent.
roles.destructive: Red. Errors, failed, remove/delete actions (as text on a secondary button).
roles.muted-foreground: Grey. Every icon and secondary text; lift to foreground on hover.
roles.surfaces: background, canvas, card, subtle, popover: solid fills only, no gradients, no shadows on panels, never a bordered box inside a bordered box.

rules: Page header: a plain title and one muted line. No icon tile, no kicker label, no decorative dots.
Inputs and selects: control-height, control-font, 1px border, focus = border and inset 1px line in primary. No glow.
Menus: menu-row-height rows, control-font text, check mark in primary on the selected row, muted hint on the right. No coloured left bars.
Buttons: secondary (neutral) by default, one cta per page, destructive text for remove.
Structure: one bordered box per group with hairline dividers between rows.

Seasons: a platform administrator or moderator can switch on a seasonal theme (Settings, Appearance). seasons.<name> overrides cta and success while it is on; keep using the roles, never a seasonal colour directly.

components.fm-btn: Neutral button. Add fm-btn-sm for toolbars, rows, banners and dialogs; fm-btn-cta for the one create button; fm-btn-danger for remove; fm-btn-invisible for icon-only and quiet actions; fm-btn-icon for square icon buttons.
components.fm-flash: Inline alert or banner: fm-flash (blue info), fm-flash-success, fm-flash-warning, fm-flash-danger, fm-flash-neutral; fm-flash-full for a page-wide banner. Children: an icon, .fm-flash-body with .fm-flash-title and a muted p, .fm-flash-actions with fm-btn-sm buttons.
components.fm-label: Small outlined pill for states and tags: fm-label, fm-label-accent, fm-label-success, fm-label-attention, fm-label-danger. fm-counter for counts.
components.fm-popover: Any floating panel (menus, hovercards, pickers). fm-menu inside it, rows are fm-menu-item (aria-checked=true draws the blue check), fm-menu-heading, fm-menu-divider.
components.fm-dialog: Modal: fm-dialog-header (fm-dialog-title + invisible close button), fm-dialog-body, fm-dialog-footer with right-aligned fm-btn-sm buttons.
components.fm-blankslate: Empty state: one muted 24px icon, fm-blankslate-title, fm-blankslate-desc, optional button.
components.fm-toast: Transient notice, popover surface with a 16px icon tinted by fm-flash-success/warning/danger.
